business_defaults.order_value: Sum fct_orders.order_total_amount once per order. Unless the user specifies a status, include all current order statuses and label the result booked order value, not recognized revenue.
business_defaults.order_count: Count rows or distinct order_id in fct_orders once per order.
business_defaults.ordered_units: Sum fct_orders.unit_count once per order, or fct_order_lines.quantity when grouping by product. Do not sum unit_count after joining orders to order lines.
business_defaults.order_date: Use fct_orders.order_date or fct_order_lines.order_date for order-created-date analysis.
business_defaults.current_inventory: Use current_inventory only for the latest available balance. It is not a daily inventory snapshot.
business_defaults.production_variance: Use fct_production_runs.quantity_variance, defined as actual_quantity minus planned_quantity.

global_limitations: The source is current-state incremental extraction, not CDC. State transitions completed between extractions may not have been observed.
A false lifecycle_fully_observed value means the warehouse did not observe every lifecycle state; it does not mean a business event never happened.
Do not calculate or claim a complete pending-to-confirmed-to-shipped funnel from observed lifecycle flags.
current_inventory contains one current row per product and cannot support historical inventory trends.
fct_maintenance can legitimately be empty because maintenance simulation has not been introduced.
The retained business data uses simulated 2026 dates. Do not silently replace a user's date range with the current calendar date.

dim_products.description: Current product catalog attributes. current_unit_price is a catalog price; use order-line unit_price for transactional product sales analysis.

fct_orders.grain: one row per current valid order
fct_orders.description: Current order header with line aggregates and only the lifecycle milestones observed by extraction.

fct_order_lines.description: Order-line facts using the price captured when the order was created and the order's current status.

fct_production_runs.description: Production execution enriched with its linked production plan.

fct_maintenance.description: Maintenance facts. This relation can be empty at the current project checkpoint.

current_inventory.grain: one row per current product inventory balance
current_inventory.description: Latest inventory balance and catalog-price retail valuation; not inventory history.

relationships.warning: Joining order headers to lines repeats header measures. Aggregate order_total_amount and unit_count before this join or use line-grain measures.
